rules.name: Overall event budget allocation
rules.description: Category allocations must not exceed the approved event budget.

rules.name: Category budget spending
rules.description: Warn when category spending exceeds its allocation.

rules.name: Positive transaction amount
rules.description: Amount must be a finite number greater than zero.

rules.name: Required transaction fields
rules.description: Required transaction fields must be present.

rules.name: Correction traceability
rules.description: Corrections need an original transaction ID and reason.

rules.name: Possible duplicate transaction
rules.description: Possible duplicates require review; do not auto-delete.
